title: Instructions for Form 2210 (2025), Underpayment of Estimated Tax by Individuals

passages.question: Is there an underpayment penalty?
passages.excerpt: If your adjusted gross income (AGI) for 2024 was more than $150,000 ($75,000 if your 2025 filing status is married filing separately), substitute 110% for 100% in (2) above.
